name: Shimotsuki Chisei
source:
First-year student at the academy.

A female student who attends the same academy that Setsuna and the others transferred to.

She founded the “Local History Study Group” at the academy, but
she is the only member and works alone.

She is skilled with her hands and good at drawing and sewing,
and she is also good with computers and has strong information gathering skills.

Her hobby is creative activities, and she tends to become absorbed in things she likes.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/Nightmare_x_Sisters_Omega/]official site[/url]]
